title: Fix fumadocs plugin preview by exporting types and loading all plugins dynamically
body:
## Fix fumadocs plugin preview by exporting SchemaNode type and dynamic plugin loading

### Problem Analysis
The fumadocs documentation cannot properly preview plugins because:
1. The `SchemaNode` type was not exported from the `InteractiveDemo` component for MDX files
2. Plugin packages were not imported, so plugin component types were not registered
3. Static imports of plugins caused SSR issues with "document is not defined" errors
4. The `plugin-object` package was missing from imports and its components lacked registration with ComponentRegistry

### Solution Implemented

**Type Exports**: Added `export type { SchemaNode }` to enable TypeScript autocomplete and validation in MDX files:
- `apps/site/app/components/InteractiveDemo.tsx`
- `apps/site/app/components/ComponentDemo.tsx`
- `apps/site/mdx-components.tsx`

**Plugin Loading**: Implemented dynamic client-side plugin loading to avoid SSR issues:
- Added all plugin packages (`@object-ui/plugin-editor`, `@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`, `@object-ui/plugin-markdown`, `@object-ui/plugin-object`) as dependencies
- Used browser-only dynamic imports with `typeof window !== 'undefined'` checks
- Added loading state in `InteractiveDemo` to wait for plugins before rendering
- Ensures plugins register correctly without breaking server-side rendering

**Plugin Object Registration**: Fixed the plugin-object package to register its components:
- Converted `packages/plugin-object/src/index.ts` to `index.tsx` to support JSX syntax
- Added `ComponentRegistry.register()` calls for `object-table`, `object-form`, and `object-view` components
- Created renderer wrappers for proper integration with the component registry
- Updated `vite.config.ts` to point to the new `.tsx` entry file

**Additional Fixes**:
- Removed unused `SchemaNode` import from `packages/types/src/feedback.ts`
- Maintained backward compatibility with plugin imports in `ObjectUIProvider`

### Testing

- ✅ Site builds successfully without SSR errors
- ✅ All plugins load dynamically and register correctly in browser
- ✅ TypeScript types properly exported for MDX files
- ✅ No "document is not defined" errors during build
- ✅ Loading state provides good UX while plugins initialize
- ✅ Plugin-object components (`object-table`, `object-form`, `object-view`) now properly registered

**Console verification**: The registered components now include: `[..., code-editor, bar-chart, chart, markdown, kanban, object-table, object-form, object-view]`

### Screenshots

**Plugin Editor documentation page:**
![Plugin Editor Preview](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a83cbc12-1b78-4705-ae98-e8e0ceaa6a7f)

**Plugin Object documentation page working:**
![Plugin Object Preview](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dc3c8777-844a-49a6-9e89-0092fd33d90a)

**All plugin components now registered:**
![Components Registered](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/57b4c89d-6c3b-41bb-ac07-8d718971cd9d)

The fumadocs plugin documentation pages now properly preview all plugin components including plugin-object with full TypeScript type support and no SSR issues.
